audit.summary: Confirmed major: 3 Confirmed minor: 4 Core result refuted: False
limitations: P1 — The retained coefficient mass and doubled zonotope centre fail — Counterevidence: The zero-mass subset alone does not refute the weaker literal Lemma14 statement with the full zonotope. The interval has averaging relations and does not refute Theorem4's conclusion.

P2 — Whole-step retention is substituted for preprocessing retention in the final product — Counterevidence: This is a counterexample to an algebraic inference, not a realized non-averaging configuration. A different bookkeeping argument can preserve sufficient size.

P3 — Lemma6 lacks an origin condition and is false for affine containing GAPs — Counterevidence: Lemma6 has no non-averaging premise. This interval example therefore fits its scope but supplies no counterexample to the main theorem. Width-one coordinates are removed in growth estimates.

P4 — Affine approximation and nonempty-index wording in Lemma2 — Counterevidence: If linear is intended colloquially to include affine, this is a terminology correction. Convex smoothing with arbitrarily small domain loss and the strict constant slack completes the corrected argument; d1 is immediate.

P5 — Width, inverse coordinates and density normalization in Lemma1 — Counterevidence: These examples refute intermediate assertions, not corrected Lemma1. The first-case gain is delta^(-.1epsilon) up to constants. In the large-K repair the actual m^(d epsilon) factor, together with u^((d-1)(2/(d+1)-epsilon)), gives delta exponent -epsilon(d+2)/(10(d+1))-(d-1)epsilon^2/10<0, so no extra m^epsilon is needed. This algebra was independently checked.
P6 — The AppendixA lift range is missing a factor n — Counterevidence: s<=n^ell gives ns^2(sn)^ell<=n^(ell^2+3ell+1), far below H=n^(10ell^3), so the local range change leaves ample no-carry slack.

P7 — Adjoining zero destroys non-averaging of the retained image — Counterevidence: The inverse identification is affine, so the unaugmented image remains non-averaging. The manuscript's later reduction already uses it. The old finite exhaustive test is retained but not claimed newly executed.

Limitations: The weighted zero-mass example refutes the retained-zonotope proof assertion, not by itself the weaker printed Lemma14 statement with the full zonotope. The doubled-centre inclusion on p.15 is also refuted after allowed trimming.
Limitations: The scalar iteration family disproves the asserted inference between displayed bounds; no actual non-averaging set realizing that sequence is claimed.
Limitations: Origin-sensitive Lemma6 is refuted under all its hypotheses by an arbitrarily large constructive family. The main theorem is not refuted.
Limitations: The potential-function bookkeeping repair is conditional on a correct geometric Case3; remaining zonotope/slab/lattice repairs are not certified complete.

Limitations: Finite calculations supplement the explicit asymptotic/all-parameter proofs; they do not enumerate all subsets for irreducibility or establish all asymptotic structural thresholds at their finite input values.

Limitations: Selected complete relevant primary proof units were checked, not all34 pages or all recursively cited literature. Literal projection/basis shortcuts in the primary reference are qualified, without asserting its structural theorem false.
Limitations: Exact assigned arXivv2 is distinguished from the frozen2025 journal identity. No version equivalence is assumed.
Limitations: No author code executed; no exact-version supplementary package identified in the bounded search, which does not establish nonexistence.
Limitations: UI identity is controller-observed; runtime GPT-6 Astra Pro. Backend equivalence not independently verified.
The finding applies to the exact reviewed source version and inspected scope; uninspected publication versions are not adjudicated.
The report retains counterevidence and unresolved questions. Publication does not repeat scientific review.
Independent human scientific adjudication remains pending; author adoption has not been requested.

repair.content:
Use actual small deletions and their retained coefficient mass>=1/3, a consistent interior scaling such as mu|A0|/4, and prove the inclusion in the retained zonotope. Track symmetric displacement bodies, rank-deficient slices, counting endpoint terms and at least two lattice points.

Keep eta and r separate. The report proves a conditional positive-power size bound using F=log M-(alpha_d+2epsilon)log V and a nonnegative increment epsilon log(1/eta)+(Kpstar-1)log(1/r)-O(1).

Require an origin-containing centered input GAP, delete width-one coordinates, and recheck every use with the origin fixed. A translation of A cannot silently transport variable-cardinality subset sums.

Say affine, require nonempty I, evaluate at v/m, and use coordinatewise derivative variation with overlap at most d. Smooth with arbitrarily small domain loss.

Use a dimension-dependent inradius constant, the half-unit translation and the normalized density fraction. Account for bounded overlap and use an enclosing vertical interval/upper volume bound in the flat case.

Use [-sn,sn]^ell; n s^2(sn)^ell<=n^(ell^2+3ell+1)<<n^(10ell^3) verifies the remaining scale.

Claim non-averaging only for phiP(Ahat), retaining0 solely in the bounding progression; restrict identification domains to the retained set until containment is arranged.
